sentences.text: 2 19-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case instituted for the offence under Sections 363,
366(A), 376(G) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 8 of the POCSO Act.
The allegation against the petitioner along with others is of kidnapping the informant and forcibly committed gang rape upon her, when she went to attend call of nature.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
He has committed no offence.
The victim girl has recovered.
From the perusal of the impugned order, it is apparent that the victim girl specifically stated that co-accused Prem Kumar and Anand Kumar committed rape upon her.

The petitioner and co-accused Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.19687 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023 namely Vikram Kumar only stand near the place of occurrence.
There is no Specific overt act against the petitioner.
He further submitted that the other co-accused has already been granted bail by a Co-ordinate Bench vide order dated 17.05.2022 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 8825 of 2022.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of the bail petition.
He is languishing in judicial custody since 30.09.2022.
